versos.grego: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ εἶναι αὐτὸν ἐν τόπῳ τινὶ προσευχόμενον, ὡς ἐπαύσατο, εἶπέν τις τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ πρὸς αὐτόν Κύριε, δίδαξον ἡμᾶς προσεύχεσθαι, καθὼς καὶ Ἰωάνης ἐδίδαξεν τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que ele estava orando em um certo lugar. Quando terminou, lhe disse um de seus discípulos: Senhor, ensina-nos a orar, como João também ensinou a seus discípulos.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς Ὅταν προσεύχησθε, λέγετε Πάτερ, ἁγιασθήτω τὸ ὄνομά σου· ἐλθάτω ἡ βασιλεία σου·

controles.web: He said to them, “When you pray, say,  ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.
controles.livre: E ele lhes disse: Quando orardes, dizei: Pai,  santificado seja o teu nome; venha o teu Reino.

versos.grego: τὸν ἄρτον ἡμῶν τὸν ἐπιούσιον δίδου ἡμῖν τὸ καθ’ ἡμέραν·

controles.web: Give us day by day our daily bread.
controles.kjv: Give us day by day our daily bread.
controles.livre: Dá-nos cada dia nosso pão diário.

versos.grego: καὶ ἄφες ἡμῖν τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν, καὶ γὰρ αὐτοὶ ἀφίομεν παντὶ ὀφείλοντι ἡμῖν· καὶ μὴ εἰσενέγκῃς ἡμᾶς εἰς πειρασμόν.

controles.web: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us.  Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”
controles.kjv: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.
controles.livre: E perdoa-nos nossos pecados, pois também perdoamos a todo aquele que nos deve. E não nos ponhas em tentação.

versos.grego: Καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Τίς ἐξ ὑμῶν ἕξει φίλον, καὶ πορεύσεται πρὸς αὐτὸν μεσονυκτίου καὶ εἴπῃ αὐτῷ Φίλε, χρῆσόν μοι τρεῖς ἄρτους,

controles.web: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight, and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;
controles.livre: Disse-lhes também: Qual de vós que, tendo um amigo, se for a ele à meia-noite, e lhe disser: Amigo, empresta-me três pães.

versos.grego: ἐπειδὴ φίλος μου παρεγένετο ἐξ ὁδοῦ πρός με καὶ οὐκ ἔχω ὃ παραθήσω αὐτῷ·

controles.web: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’
controles.kjv: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?
controles.livre: Porque um amigo meu veio de viagem até mim, e nada tenho para lhe apresentar.

versos.grego: κἀκεῖνος ἔσωθεν ἀποκριθεὶς εἴπῃ Μή μοι κόπους πάρεχε· ἤδη ἡ θύρα κέκλεισται, καὶ τὰ παιδία μου μετ’ ἐμοῦ εἰς τὴν κοίτην εἰσίν· οὐ δύναμαι ἀναστὰς δοῦναί σοι.

controles.web: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?
controles.kjv: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.
controles.livre: E ele de dentro, respondendo, disser: Não me perturbe! A porta já está fechada, e meus filhos estão comigo na cama; não posso me levantar para te dar.

versos.grego: λέγω ὑμῖν, εἰ καὶ οὐ δώσει αὐτῷ ἀναστὰς διὰ τὸ εἶναι φίλον αὐτοῦ, διά γε τὴν ἀναιδίαν αὐτοῦ ἐγερθεὶς δώσει αὐτῷ ὅσων χρῄζει.

controles.web: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.
controles.kjv: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.
controles.livre: Digo-vos, que ainda que ele não se levante para lhe dar por seu seu amigo, contudo, por sua teimosia ele se levantará, e lhe dará tudo quanto ele precisar.

versos.grego: Κἀγὼ ὑμῖν λέγω, αἰτεῖτε, καὶ δοθήσεται ὑμῖν· ζητεῖτε, καὶ εὑρήσετε· κρούετε, καὶ ἀνοιγήσεται ὑμῖν·

controles.web: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.
controles.kjv: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
controles.livre: E eu vos digo: pedi, e será vos dado; buscai, e achareis; batei, e vos será aberto.

versos.grego: πᾶς γὰρ ὁ αἰτῶν λαμβάνει, καὶ ὁ ζητῶν εὑρίσκει, καὶ τῷ κρούοντι ἀνοιγήσεται.

controles.web: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
controles.kjv: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
controles.livre: Porque todo o que pede, recebe; e quem busca, acha; e quem bate, lhe será aberto.

versos.grego: τίνα δὲ ἐξ ὑμῶν τὸν πατέρα αἰτήσει ὁ υἱὸς ἰχθύν, μὴ ἀντὶ ἰχθύος ὄφιν αὐτῷ ἐπιδώσει;

controles.web: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?
controles.kjv: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?
controles.livre: E que pai, dentre vós, a quem o filho pedir peixe,  no lugar do peixe lhe dará uma serpente?

versos.grego: ἢ καὶ αἰτήσει ᾠόν, ἐπιδώσει αὐτῷ σκορπίον;

controles.web: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?
controles.kjv: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
controles.livre: Ou se também pedir um ovo, lhe dará um escorpião?

versos.grego: εἰ οὖν ὑμεῖς πονηροὶ ὑπάρχοντες οἴδατε δόματα ἀγαθὰ διδόναι τοῖς τέκνοις ὑμῶν, πόσῳ μᾶλλον ὁ Πατὴρ ὁ ἐξ οὐρανοῦ δώσει Πνεῦμα Ἅγιον τοῖς αἰτοῦσιν αὐτόν.

controles.web: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”
controles.kjv: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?
controles.livre: Pois se vós, sendo maus, sabeis dar bons presentes para vossos filhos, quanto mais dará vosso Pai celestial, o Espírito Santo, a aqueles que lhe pedirem?

versos.grego: Καὶ ἦν ἐκβάλλων δαιμόνιον, καὶ αὐτὸ ἦν κωφόν· ἐγένετο δὲ τοῦ δαιμονίου ἐξελθόντος ἐλάλησεν ὁ κωφός. καὶ ἐθαύμασαν οἱ ὄχλοι·

controles.web: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.
controles.kjv: And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spake; and the people wondered.
controles.livre: E Jesus estava expulsando um demônio, e este era mudo. E aconteceu que, saindo o demônio, o mudo falou, e as multidões se maravilharam.

versos.grego: τινὲς δὲ ἐξ αὐτῶν εἶπαν Ἐν Βεελζεβοὺλ τῷ ἄρχοντι τῶν δαιμονίων ἐκβάλλει τὰ δαιμόνια·

controles.web: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
controles.kjv: But some of them said, He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils.
controles.livre: Porém alguns deles diziam: Ele expulsa aos demônios por Belzebu, príncipe dos demônios!

versos.grego: ἕτεροι δὲ πειράζοντες σημεῖον ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἐζήτουν παρ’ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.
controles.kjv: And others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.
controles.livre: E outros, tentando -o ,pediam-lhe um sinal do céu.

versos.grego: αὐτὸς δὲ εἰδὼς αὐτῶν τὰ διανοήματα εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Πᾶσα βασιλεία ἐφ’ ἑαυτὴν διαμερισθεῖσα ἐρημοῦται, καὶ οἶκος ἐπὶ οἶκον πίπτει.

controles.web: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.
controles.kjv: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.
controles.livre: Mas ele, conhecendo seus pensamentos, disse-lhes: Todo reino dividido contra si mesmo é transformado num vazio, e a casa contra casa cai.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ καὶ ὁ Σατανᾶς ἐφ’ ἑαυτὸν διεμερίσθη, πῶς σταθήσεται ἡ βασιλεία αὐτοῦ; ὅτι λέγετε ἐν Βεελζεβοὺλ ἐκβάλλειν με τὰ δαιμόνια.

controles.web: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.
controles.kjv: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.
controles.livre: E se também Satanás está dividido contra si mesmo, como durará o seu reino? Porque dizeis: Por Belzebu ele expulsa aos demônios.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ ἐγὼ ἐν Βεελζεβοὺλ ἐκβάλλω τὰ δαιμόνια, οἱ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν ἐν τίνι ἐκβάλλουσιν; διὰ τοῦτο αὐτοὶ ὑμῶν κριταὶ ἔσονται.

controles.web: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore will they be your judges.
controles.kjv: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.
controles.livre: E se eu expulso aos demônios por Belzebu, por quem os seus filhos expulsam? Portanto eles serão vossos juízes.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ ἐν δακτύλῳ Θεοῦ ἐγὼ ἐκβάλλω τὰ δαιμόνια, ἄρα ἔφθασεν ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: But if I by the finger of God cast out demons, then the Kingdom of God has come to you.
controles.kjv: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.
controles.livre: Mas se eu expulso aos demônios pelo dedo de Deus, portanto o Reino de Deus chegou a vós.

versos.grego: ὅταν ὁ ἰσχυρὸς καθωπλισμένος φυλάσσῃ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ αὐλήν, ἐν εἰρήνῃ ἐστὶν τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.
controles.kjv: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:
controles.livre: Quando o valente, armado, guarda seu palácio, seus bens estão em paz.

versos.grego: ἐπὰν δὲ ἰσχυρότερος αὐτοῦ ἐπελθὼν νικήσῃ αὐτόν, τὴν πανοπλίαν αὐτοῦ αἴρει ἐφ’ ᾗ ἐπεποίθει, καὶ τὰ σκῦλα αὐτοῦ διαδίδωσιν.

controles.web: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.
controles.kjv: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.
controles.livre: Mas vindo outro mais valente que ele, e vencendo-o, toma -lhe toda sua armadura, em que confiava, e reparte seus despojos.

versos.grego: Ὁ μὴ ὢν μετ’ ἐμοῦ κατ’ ἐμοῦ ἐστιν, καὶ ὁ μὴ συνάγων μετ’ ἐμοῦ σκορπίζει.

controles.web: “He that is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.
controles.kjv: He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.
controles.livre: Quem não é comigo, é contra mim; e quem comigo não ajunta, espalha.

versos.grego: Ὅταν τὸ ἀκάθαρτον πνεῦμα ἐξέλθῃ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου, διέρχεται δι’ ἀνύδρων τόπων ζητοῦν ἀνάπαυσιν, καὶ μὴ εὑρίσκον λέγει Ὑποστρέψω εἰς τὸν οἶκόν μου ὅθεν ἐξῆλθον·

controles.web: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest, and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’
controles.kjv: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return unto my house whence I came out.
controles.livre: Quando o espírito imundo tem saído da pessoa, ele anda por lugares secos, buscando repouso; e não o achando, diz: Voltarei para minha casa, de onde saí.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐλθὸν εὑρίσκει σεσαρωμένον καὶ κεκοσμημένον.

controles.web: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.
controles.kjv: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.
controles.livre: E vindo, acha-a varrida e adornada.

versos.grego: τότε πορεύεται καὶ παραλαμβάνει ἕτερα πνεύματα πονηρότερα ἑαυτοῦ ἑπτά, καὶ εἰσελθόντα κατοικεῖ ἐκεῖ, καὶ γίνεται τὰ ἔσχατα τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκείνου χείρονα τῶν πρώτων.

controles.web: Then he goes, and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”
controles.kjv: Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first.
controles.livre: Então vai, e toma consigo outros sete espíritos piores que ele, e entrando, habitam ali; e as últimas coisas de tal pessoa são piores que as primeiras.

versos.grego: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ λέγειν αὐτὸν ταῦτα ἐπάρασά τις φωνὴν γυνὴ ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου εἶπεν αὐτῷ Μακαρία ἡ κοιλία ἡ βαστάσασά σε καὶ μαστοὶ οὓς ἐθήλασας.

controles.web: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice, and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, as he spake these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the paps which thou hast sucked.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, dizendo ele estas coisas, uma mulher da multidão, levantando a voz, lhe disse: Bem-aventurado o ventre que te trouxe, e os peitos que mamaste!

versos.grego: αὐτὸς δὲ εἶπεν Μενοῦν μακάριοι οἱ ἀκούοντες τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ φυλάσσοντες.

controles.web: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”
controles.kjv: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.
controles.livre: Mas ele disse: Antes bem-aventurados os que ouvem a palavra de Deus, e a guardam.

versos.grego: Τῶν δὲ ὄχλων ἐπαθροιζομένων ἤρξατο λέγειν Ἡ γενεὰ αὕτη γενεὰ πονηρά ἐστιν· σημεῖον ζητεῖ, καὶ σημεῖον οὐ δοθήσεται αὐτῇ εἰ μὴ τὸ σημεῖον Ἰωνᾶ.

controles.web: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah, the prophet.
controles.kjv: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.
controles.livre: E ajuntando as multidões, começou a dizer: Maligna é esta geração; busca sinal, mas sinal não lhe será dado, a não ser o sinal de Jonas o profeta.

versos.grego: καθὼς γὰρ ἐγένετο Ἰωνᾶς τοῖς Νινευείταις σημεῖον, οὕτως ἔσται καὶ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τῇ γενεᾷ ταύτῃ.

controles.web: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so will also the Son of Man be to this generation.
controles.kjv: For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.
controles.livre: Porque como Jonas foi sinal para os ninivitas, assim também será o Filho do homem para esta geração.

versos.grego: βασίλισσα νότου ἐγερθήσεται ἐν τῇ κρίσει μετὰ τῶν ἀνδρῶν τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης καὶ κατακρινεῖ αὐτούς· ὅτι ἦλθεν ἐκ τῶν περάτων τῆς γῆς ἀκοῦσαι τὴν σοφίαν Σολομῶνος, καὶ ἰδοὺ πλεῖον Σολομῶνος ὧδε.

controles.web: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and will condemn them: for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.
controles.kjv: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here.
controles.livre: A rainha do Sul se levantará em juízo com as pessoas desta geração, e as condenará; pois até dos fins da terra veio para ouvir a sabedoria de Salomão; e eis que mais que Salomão está aqui.

versos.grego: ἄνδρες Νινευεῖται ἀναστήσονται ἐν τῇ κρίσει μετὰ τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης καὶ κατακρινοῦσιν αὐτήν· ὅτι μετενόησαν εἰς τὸ κήρυγμα Ἰωνᾶ, καὶ ἰδοὺ πλεῖον Ἰωνᾶ ὧδε.

controles.web: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.
controles.kjv: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
controles.livre: Os homens de Nínive se levantarão em juízo com esta geração, e a condenarão; pois com a pregação de Jonas se converteram; e eis que mais que Jonas está aqui.

versos.grego: Οὐδεὶς λύχνον ἅψας εἰς κρύπτην τίθησιν οὐδὲ ὑπὸ τὸν μόδιον, ἀλλ’ ἐπὶ τὴν λυχνίαν, ἵνα οἱ εἰσπορευόμενοι τὸ φέγγος βλέπωσιν.

controles.web: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.
controles.kjv: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, putteth it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light.
controles.livre: E ninguém, acendendo a lâmpada, a põe em lugar oculto, nem debaixo da caixa, mas na luminária, para que os que entrarem vejam a luz.

versos.grego: ὁ λύχνος τοῦ σώματός ἐστιν ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου. ὅταν ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου ἁπλοῦς ᾖ, καὶ ὅλον τὸ σῶμά σου φωτεινόν ἐστιν· ἐπὰν δὲ πονηρὸς ᾖ, καὶ τὸ σῶμά σου σκοτεινόν.

controles.web: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.
controles.kjv: The light of the body is the eye: therefore when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when thine eye is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.
controles.livre: A lâmpada do corpo é o olho. Sendo pois teu olho bom, também todo teu corpo será luminoso; porém se for mau, também todo teu corpo será tenebroso.

versos.grego: σκόπει οὖν μὴ τὸ φῶς τὸ ἐν σοὶ σκότος ἐστίν.

controles.web: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.
controles.kjv: Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness.
controles.livre: Olha pois que a luz que em ti há não sejam trevas.

versos.grego: εἰ οὖν τὸ σῶμά σου ὅλον φωτεινόν, μὴ ἔχον μέρος τι σκοτεινόν, ἔσται φωτεινὸν ὅλον ὡς ὅταν ὁ λύχνος τῇ ἀστραπῇ φωτίζῃ σε.

controles.web: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”
controles.kjv: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.
controles.livre: Então se sendo teu corpo todo luminoso, não tendo parte alguma escura, ele todo será iluminado, como quando a lâmpada com seu brilho te ilumina.

versos.grego: Ἐν δὲ τῷ λαλῆσαι ἐρωτᾷ αὐτὸν Φαρισαῖος ὅπως ἀριστήσῃ παρ’ αὐτῷ· εἰσελθὼν δὲ ἀνέπεσεν.

controles.web: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in, and sat at the table.
controles.kjv: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
controles.livre: E estando ele ainda falando, um fariseu lhe rogou que viesse para jantar com ele; e entrando, sentou-se à mesa ;

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Φαρισαῖος ἰδὼν ἐθαύμασεν ὅτι οὐ πρῶτον ἐβαπτίσθη πρὸ τοῦ ἀρίστου.

controles.web: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.
controles.kjv: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.
controles.livre: E vendo -o o fariseu, maravilhou-se de que não tinha se lavado antes de jantar.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Κύριος πρὸς αὐτόν Νῦν ὑμεῖς οἱ Φαρισαῖοι τὸ ἔξωθεν τοῦ ποτηρίου καὶ τοῦ πίνακος καθαρίζετε, τὸ δὲ ἔσωθεν ὑμῶν γέμει ἁρπαγῆς καὶ πονηρίας.

controles.web: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.
controles.livre: E o Senhor lhe disse: Agora vós, os fariseus, limpais o exterior do copo e do prato; porém vosso interior está cheio de roubo e maldade.

versos.grego: ἄφρονες, οὐχ ὁ ποιήσας τὸ ἔξωθεν καὶ τὸ ἔσωθεν ἐποίησεν;

controles.web: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?
controles.kjv: Ye fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also?
controles.livre: Loucos, o que fez o exterior não fez também o interior?

versos.grego: πλὴν τὰ ἐνόντα δότε ἐλεημοσύνην, καὶ ἰδοὺ πάντα καθαρὰ ὑμῖν ἐστιν.

controles.web: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.
controles.kjv: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.
controles.livre: Porém daí de esmola o que tendes; e eis que tudo vos será limpo.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ οὐαὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς Φαρισαίοις, ὅτι ἀποδεκατοῦτε τὸ ἡδύοσμον καὶ τὸ πήγανον καὶ πᾶν λάχανον, καὶ παρέρχεσθε τὴν κρίσιν καὶ τὴν ἀγάπην τοῦ Θεοῦ· ταῦτα δὲ ἔδει ποιῆσαι κἀκεῖνα μὴ παρεῖναι.

controles.web: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and the love of God. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.
controles.kjv: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
controles.livre: Mais ai de vós, fariseus, que dizimais a hortelã, e a arruda, e toda hortaliça; e pelo juízo e amor de Deus passais longe. Estas coisas era necessário fazer, e não deixar as outras.

versos.grego: οὐαὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς Φαρισαίοις, ὅτι ἀγαπᾶτε τὴν πρωτοκαθεδρίαν ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς καὶ τοὺς ἀσπασμοὺς ἐν ταῖς ἀγοραῖς.

controles.web: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues, and the greetings in the marketplaces.
controles.kjv: Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.
controles.livre: Ai de vós, fariseus, que amais os primeiros assentos nas sinagogas, e as saudações nas praças.

versos.grego: οὐαὶ ὑμῖν, ὅτι ἐστὲ ὡς τὰ μνημεῖα τὰ ἄδηλα, καὶ οἱ ἄνθρωποι οἱ περιπατοῦντες ἐπάνω οὐκ οἴδασιν.

controles.web: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”
controles.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.
controles.livre: Ai de vós,  que sois como as sepulturas disfarçadas, e as pessoas que andam sobre elas não sabem.

versos.grego: Ἀποκριθεὶς δέ τις τῶν νομικῶν λέγει αὐτῷ Διδάσκαλε, ταῦτα λέγων καὶ ἡμᾶς ὑβρίζεις.

controles.web: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”
controles.kjv: Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.
controles.livre: E respondendo um dos estudiosos da Lei, disse-lhe: Mestre, quando dizes isto também afrontas a nós.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Καὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς νομικοῖς οὐαί, ὅτι φορτίζετε τοὺς ἀνθρώπους φορτία δυσβάστακτα, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἑνὶ τῶν δακτύλων ὑμῶν οὐ προσψαύετε τοῖς φορτίοις.

controles.web: He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.
controles.kjv: And he said, Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.
controles.livre: Porém ele disse: Ai de vós também, estudiosos da Lei, que carregais as pessoas com cargas pesadas para levar, e vós mesmos nem ainda com um de vossos dedos tais cargas tocais.

versos.grego: οὐαὶ ὑμῖν, ὅτι οἰκοδομεῖτε τὰ μνημεῖα τῶν προφητῶν, οἱ δὲ πατέρες ὑμῶν ἀπέκτειναν αὐτούς.

controles.web: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
controles.kjv: Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
controles.livre: Ai de vós, que construís os sepulcros dos profetas, e vossos pais os mataram.

versos.grego: ἄρα μάρτυρές ἐστε καὶ συνευδοκεῖτε τοῖς ἔργοις τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν, ὅτι αὐτοὶ μὲν ἀπέκτειναν αὐτοὺς, ὑμεῖς δὲ οἰκοδομεῖτε.

controles.web: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.
controles.kjv: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.
controles.livre: Bem testemunhais pois, que também consentis nas obras de vossos pais; porque eles os mataram, e vós edificais seus sepulcros.

versos.grego: διὰ τοῦτο καὶ ἡ σοφία τοῦ Θεοῦ εἶπεν Ἀποστελῶ εἰς αὐτοὺς προφήτας καὶ ἀποστόλους, καὶ ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀποκτενοῦσιν καὶ διώξουσιν,

controles.web: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,
controles.kjv: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute:
controles.livre: Portanto também diz a sabedoria de Deus: Profetas e apóstolos lhes mandarei; e deles a uns matarão, e a outros lançarão fora;

versos.grego: ἵνα ἐκζητηθῇ τὸ αἷμα πάντων τῶν προφητῶν τὸ ἐκκεχυμένον ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου ἀπὸ τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης,

controles.web: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
controles.kjv: That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
controles.livre: Para que desta geração seja requerido o sangue de todos os profetas, que foi derramado desde a fundação do mundo;

versos.grego: ἀπὸ αἵματος Ἄβελ ἕως αἵματος Ζαχαρίου τοῦ ἀπολομένου μεταξὺ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ τοῦ οἴκου· ναί, λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐκζητηθήσεται ἀπὸ τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης.

controles.web: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.
controles.kjv: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias, which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation.
controles.livre: Desde o sangue de Abel, até o sangue de Zacarias, que foi morto entre o altar e a casa de Deus ; assim vos digo, será requerido desta geração.

versos.grego: οὐαὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς νομικοῖς, ὅτι ἤρατε τὴν κλεῖδα τῆς γνώσεως· αὐτοὶ οὐκ εἰσήλθατε καὶ τοὺς εἰσερχομένους ἐκωλύσατε.

controles.web: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”
controles.kjv: Woe unto you, lawyers! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.
controles.livre: Ai de vós, estudiosos da Lei, que tomastes a chave do conhecimento; vós mesmos não entrastes, e impedistes aos que estavam entrando.

versos.grego: Κἀκεῖθεν ἐξελθόντος αὐτοῦ ἤρξαντο οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι δεινῶς ἐνέχειν καὶ ἀποστοματίζειν αὐτὸν περὶ πλειόνων,

controles.web: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him;
controles.kjv: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:
controles.livre: E dizendo-lhes estas coisas, os escribas e os fariseus começaram a apertá-lo fortemente, e tentar lhe fazer falar de muitas coisas,

versos.grego: ἐνεδρεύοντες αὐτὸν θηρεῦσαί τι ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.
controles.kjv: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.
controles.livre: armando-lhe ciladas, e procurando caçar alguma coisa de sua boca, para o poderem acusar.
